about: Special days on the archive calendars. type 'maintenance': the site was down; shows 8 PM red ('Maintenance · nothing published'), not clickable, never counts as published, ignored if the date has an edition. type 'launch': launch day; shows the aqua-green theme color ('Launch day'); not clickable when it has no editions, otherwise the day stays clickable with a green ring. 'windows': scheduled maintenance windows for the header countdown (assets/countdown.js). start/end are America/Vancouver wall-clock 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM', end inclusive through that minute. Inside a window the countdown pill is replaced by a banner (label + text) and slots in the window are skipped; when it ends the pill returns by itself. Windows don't color the calendar: add the dates under 'days' too. Add an entry here and run tools/publish.py.

windows.label: Scheduled maintenance
